L3@P0: S&P DOW JONES INDICES AND MSCI ANNOUNCE SELECT
L4@P0: LIST OF COMPANIES IMPACTED BY REVISIONS TO THE
L5@P0: GLOBAL INDUSTRY CLASSIFICATION STANDARD (GICS®)
L6@P0: STRUCTURE IN 2023
L7@P0: NEW YORK, JUNE 30, 2022 - S&P Dow Jones Indices (“S&P DJI”), a leading provider of financial
L8@P0: market indices, and MSCI Inc. (MSCI), a leading provider of critical decision support tools and
L9@P0: services for the global investment community, announced today a select list of companies
L10@P0: expected to be impacted by the previously announced Global Industry Classification Standard
L11@P0: (GICS®) structure revisions set to be effective March 2023 in GICS Direct. The list, found here,
L12@P0: was determined using market capitalization of USD $2 billion as a general guideline. Note that
L13@P0: the new company classifications are subject to change before implementation due to ongoing
L14@P0: reviews, including for corporate events.
L15@P0: The annual GICS methodology review is intended to ensure that the GICS structure continues to
L16@P0: appropriately represent the global equity markets and, thereby, enable asset owners, asset
L17@P0: managers and investment research specialists to make consistent global comparisons by
L18@P0: industry. The GICS structure revision is the result of a consultation with market participants.
L19@P0: The changes to the GICS structure will be implemented in GICS Direct and S&P DJI’s indices
L20@P0: after the close of business (ET) on Friday, March 17, 2023. A select list of large market
L21@P0: capitalization companies affected by the changes is being announced today. The full list of
L22@P0: companies affected by these changes will be made available to clients no later than December
L23@P0: 15, 2022. MSCI will consult with clients regarding implementation in their indexes.
L24@P0: For a detailed document covering the upcoming changes, please visit S&P Dow Jones Indices’
L25@P0: web site at https://www.spglobal.com/spdji/en/ and MSCI’s web site at www.msci.com.

L29@P1: ABOUT S&P DOW JONES INDICES
L30@P1: S&P Dow Jones Indices is the largest global resource for essential index-based concepts, data and
L31@P1: research, and home to iconic financial market indicators, such as the S&P 500® and the Dow Jones
L32@P1: Industrial Average®. More assets are invested in products based on our indices than products based on
L33@P1: indices from any other provider in the world. Since Charles Dow invented the first index in 1884, S&P DJI
L34@P1: has been innovating and developing indices across the spectrum of asset classes that have helped define
L35@P1: the way investors measure and trade the markets.
L36@P1: S&P Dow Jones Indices is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI), which provides essential intelligence
L37@P1: for individuals, companies, and governments to make decisions with confidence. For more information, visit
L38@P1: www.spglobal.com/spdji.

L44@P1: ABOUT MSCI
L45@P1: MSCI is a leading provider of critical decision support tools and services for the global investment
L46@P1: community. With over 50 years of expertise in research, data and technology, we power better investment
L47@P1: decisions by enabling clients to understand and analyze key drivers of risk and return and confidently build
L48@P1: more effective portfolios. We create industry-leading research-enhanced solutions that clients use to gain
L49@P1: insight into and improve transparency across the investment process.
